title: AEF 1.0: metrics.json
description: The metrics this run reports. A metric with direction none is shown, never coloured as better or worse.

schemaVersion.description: The AEF version this document follows, MAJOR.MINOR: 1.0 for AEF 1.0 (VER-1).

metrics.description: Every metric a result or the summary names, each declared once (SUM-1).

id.description: The metric's id, unique in this file; results and the summary name metrics by it (SUM-1).

kind.description: score, rate, count, duration, cost or verdict. In the summary a rate or verdict line counts 1 when passed, else 0; a count is summed and every other kind averaged (SUM-1, SUM-4, SUM-5).

direction.description: Which way is better: higher_better, lower_better or none. A metric with none is never shown as better or worse, and cannot regress in a comparison (SUM-1, LANE-7).

scale.description: The metric's range: unbounded, or min and max with min not above max (SUM-1).

min.description: The lowest value on the scale; not above max (SUM-1).

max.description: The highest value on the scale; not below min (SUM-1).

unit.description: The unit of the values, such as ms.

description.description: What the metric measures, for display.

ext.description: Producer extensions, named reverse-DNS or with the producer's prefix. A reader ignores what it does not know; never holds a secret (ENC-19).
